changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_metric ADD CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_metric_calculator CHECK (calculator IN ( 'OVERDUE_BUCKET_COUNT', 'RESTRUCTURING_COUNT', 'BUREAU_REQUESTS_COUNT', 'NEW_CREDITS_COUNT', 'KIB_REFUSAL_STATUSES', 'KIB_ACTIVE_DISPUTES', 'KIB_UNJUSTIFIED_DISPUTES', 'CURRENT_OVERDUE_DAYS', 'CURRENT_OVERDUE_AMOUNT', 'OPEN_CREDITS_COUNT')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_metric_params_is_array CHECK (jsonb_typeof(params) = 'array')
